children: Polymarket has fully launched perpetual contract trading, allowing users to trade cryptocurrencies, stocks, commodities, and other assets with up to 20x leverage. According to Odaily, the platform had previously added trading for selected assets on July 9, 2026, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, gold, and the S&P 500, with support for 10 assets in total and the same maximum leverage. It has now expanded to broader perpetual futures trading.

title: Polymarket Launches Perpetual Futures Trading With Up to 20x Leverage
